thread:
Ellen (PM): proposing an "escort" rollout pattern for priority-routing. idea: staged tenant "escorts" that get a short warmup + monitored surge window before full opt-in. keeps caches hot and limits blast radius. feedback? :thinking_face:
Marcus (SRE): like a rolling canary but tenant-first. require per-escort safety gates: p95 latency < 320ms and error < 0.6% for 10m. if breached, auto-escort-drop + alert.
Jun (Backend): implementation sketch: escort config at tenant-level with fields: windows, warmup QPS, token budget. sample YAML:
```
escorts:
  - tenant: t-222
    window: "02:00-04:00 UTC"
    warmup_qps: 20
    token_budget_per_min: 10000
    fallback: baseline_v3
```
Claire (Sales): customers like predictable behavior. can we offer a paid "escort+support" plan where sales can request a surgical re-enable within 3h with on-call approval? will help enterprise deals.
Marcus (SRE): surgical re-enable ok but gated: manual ticket, small staged reenable (1% traffic) then monitor 30m. ops-bot should annotate audit trail and require two approvers for high-QPS tenants.
ops-bot: rule created: "escort-safety" -> if p95>320ms for 10m OR errors>0.6% for 10m then set flag tenant_priority=false for affected tenant and open incident. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/escort-fallback
Ellen (PM): acceptance for GA: escort config UI + API, ops-bot safety rule, runbook + surgical re-enable flow, A/B or cohort check for quality, and a customer comms template. action items: Jun -> API + sample YAML (today), Marcus -> ops-bot rule + dashboards (EOD), Claire -> draft sales addendum (tomorrow). target: first escort next Thursday during warm window. :rocket:
